predicate.label: geographical part of
predicate.definition: Named geographic area, neighborhood or district X is contained within geographic place Y.
ambiguous: place names attached through an omitted institution
predicate.scope_notes: Includes: area/section/neighborhood/district of or in; clear place-to-containing-place attachment. Excludes: organization subsidiary or location; residence/work/travel; an event in a place. Ambiguous unless resolved by case-local evidence: place names attached through an omitted institution.

rationale: Section/area/neighborhood-of/in dominate P0–P4 (18 rows) with additional geographic-area paths. Travel, school and incidental location do not automatically establish containment.
